MAR.note: CNDP hearings on AI and personal data aim at a future deliberation; no rule or draft stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing stated.

facts.fact: The CNDP, Morocco's personal data protection commission, launched hearings on 18 March 2025 and heard experts, associations and parties through 2025 to prepare a deliberation on AI and personal data.

systems.owner: Commission Nationale de Controle de la Protection des Donnees a Caractere Personnel

facts.fact: The CNDP launched hearings on 18 March 2025 and held them through 2025 to prepare a deliberation on AI and personal data, so the body is acting.
